newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks ease at opening in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks ease at opening in light trade.

text.p: Australian shares eased at the start on Wednesday with light trade and no real trend apparent. The All Ordinaries index was down three points at 2,575.9.
The market looked set for a day of consolidation after its recent record breaking run, although firmer finishes offshore underpinned a generally solid tone.
"There is no real trend and only very small volumes," said dealer Brett O'Donovan of Brisbane brokerage Lance Jones.
"There is really not much happening at all," he said.

BHP continued its downward run, dipping to A$18.21 (US$13.84) before buyers gave some support to bring it back to near square. From Monday's high of A$19.42, prior to the fourth quarter profit warning, the market leader had lost over six percent to Wednesday's low.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about five to four, while about 48 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
